topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: The city's edges blur, a vast tangle of paths and signs. Each step, a pulse of the unknown. I traced the lines of this new map, the curves and shadows, till the paper thread of chance wove us close. I can't ignore the pull, the way the air shifts when you're near, how the world shrinks to the space between us. I don't know the rules here, the dance of approach and retreat. Everything feels urgent, the way the leaves rustle with secrets, the path ahead more tangled, yet I can't stay still. What if the map folds, the threads fray? The city's hum grows louder, a chorus of whispers, warning and urging in equal measure. What do I do now?
